runtime_reused: agent_prompts provenance/failure rule sections (AST literals only)
prompt_formats Anima syntax/conflict/subject-binding sections without exemplar scenes
compatibility: Existing bot interface, moderation and output screening retained; upstream tag tools use bounded per-call transport and no unbounded retry loop.

reviewed_not_enabled.output_contract.response_format_settings: Partially reused: optional NativePoolProvider.send_json sends json_object for plan/audit and json_schema for assembly/repair when the gateway accepts it; a rejected response_format falls back to prompt-only. The normal send() path and global model transport are unchanged.
reviewed_not_enabled.cache.compute_edit/BaselineStore: Deferred: requires explicit continued-edit semantics and per-session+per-user isolation. Global baseline can leak previous character/style.
reviewed_not_enabled.Medium/High agent_loop: Deferred: current bounded Low flow already covers needed tag lookups; extra loops add unpredictable latency. Native optional concept lookup reuses existing bot search service.
reviewed_not_enabled.get_artist_recommendations: Explicit opt-in only; do not silently choose an unrequested artist.
reviewed_not_enabled.reference-image prompt reversal: Useful future opt-in mode; not auto-enabled because reference details may conflict with user edits and must not be treated as established character identity.
reviewed_not_enabled.MOSS Layout/editor/compiler: Not Anima model input; explicit layout-specific feature only.
reviewed_not_enabled.message_protocol Gemini tool history rew: Not needed in current pipeline: no assistant function-call history is sent to the formatter.
reviewed_not_enabled.diagnostics.py: No full import; existing bot diagnostics retained, research transport redacts auth and excludes image request bodies.

local_adaptations: Stage-scoped plan metadata vs visual envelope; final bot interface unchanged
Strict duplicate-free stage JSON and upstream exact envelope validation
Source-linked explicit visual fact ledger; no unsolicited staging checklist

Quote-grounded semantic audit: every issue must quote verbatim text from the current draft; unquotable complaints are discarded instead of triggering a correction. Up to two bounded repairs, each independently rechecked; a correction that drops stated facts is rejected.
Recovery accepts only moderation and faithful translation, never formatter/tags/metadata
Optional native search supports short public concepts as well as artist/character names
Do not inject generic default staging or multi-character example scenes into the system; keep explicit user layout unchanged

Style/lettering stability negatives (monochrome/sketch/lineart for default anime, text/watermark/signature when unrequested) and light underwear/lingerie guidance only for neutral or unknown-tone topics
